powerDroidInteraction.finding: Adding Vader exposed an existing currentPower timing error: an unresolved +1 draw incorrectly changed a lower-power comparison into a tie.
powerDroidInteraction.sourceSemantics: EG-6 identifies its actual drawn card and compares battle power; it does not require the modified destiny to remain zero. GEMP installs total battle destiny after the complete draw group callback. Current and earlier draws in that still-pending group are excluded; completed opponent destiny remains included.
powerDroidInteraction.verification: Existing executed power-support reference observations retained byte-for-byte; dark before7/after14 again agrees. Added native multiple-draw case where preceding destiny2 remains outside the unfinished group total during the trigger.
powerDroidInteraction.limitations: The new multiple-draw test is native integration plus source timing review; it is not a newly executed GEMP oracle.
